newsitem.title: USA: Trinity Biotech buys Clark Laboratories.
newsitem.headline: Trinity Biotech buys Clark Laboratories.

text.p: Trinity Biotech Plc on Monday said it acquired Clark Laboratories Inc for about $6.2 million in stock and cash.
Clark, based in Jamestown, N.Y., is a maker of infectious disease and auto-immune diagnostic kits. Trinity said the acquisition would immediately enhance its earnings.
Trinity will issue 1,427,142 shares of common stock in exchange for all outstanding shares of Clark, and redeem Clark's preferred stock for about $1.5 million.

About two-thirds of the issued shares will be subject to a one to two-year lock-up. Trinity has the option of buying them back any time over the next two years at a premium ranging from 13 percent to 25 percent of the issued price.

As a result of the acquisition, Trinity said it would also acquire seven percent of CLI Oncology, a private company established by Clark to develop a patented technology related to the diagnosis of cancer.

Trinity said an important benefit of the deal was Clark's exclusive agreement to supply the Wampole Laboratories unit of Carter-Wallace Inc with all of its Food and Drug Administration-approved diagnostic kits in the United States.
